reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it is framed as an explanatory breakdown of DeFi GeneX and DeFi concepts and includes a disclaimer that it is not investment advice. The package returns, investment example, referral-linked bonuses, level-based income, and contest rewards are described as displayed or reported claims, without established payouts, losses, transaction outcomes, or a deceptive mechanism.

citations.quote: In this video, we break down the concept of decentralized applications, smart contract systems, and how modern DeFi platforms are evolving on BNB Smart Chain.
For more details, please contact us if you are interested in joining, i have provided contact numbers in the description

opening.argument: Judge, the return claims are tied to a step the viewer can take. The presentation says signing in can increase monthly income, then walks through priced packages and a 35-day income example. The package slides make that connection more direct: a stated daily ROI and total return appear beside an “INVEST NOW” button. The closing directs interested viewers to contact details or the company website. Taken together, this is a pitch to enter a paid return plan, not merely a discussion of how DeFi works.

citations.quote: if you signed in that, your income can be increased monthly to hundred dollars
they said after 35 days income of these would be 1638 USD
For details on the situation please go to the contact details in the description or you can go to the company official website to get the details

rebuttal.rebuttal: The educational description does not account for the investment button placed beside a daily ROI claim. Nor does the disclaimer erase the on-screen invitation to invest. The defense is right that no completed payout or loss is shown; that absence does not make the pairing of a projected return with an investment action merely conceptual.

citations.quote: In this video, we break down the concept of decentralized applications, smart contract systems, and how modern DeFi platforms are evolving on BNB Smart Chain.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The package card and button show what the plan claims and offers, but they do not establish that its returns are fabricated or that anyone was induced into a harmful transaction. The speaker attributes the 35-day figure to what “they said,” and the video opens by telling viewers to make their own decision before investing. The direct call to act deserves scrutiny, but these sources still support an explanation of a proposed plan rather than proof of a scam.

citations.quote: they said after 35 days income of these would be 1638 USD

opening.argument: Judge, consider the reward structure as a whole. The video lists referral, time-travel and DNA matching bonuses; its calculator totals earnings from one referred user’s investment. Another slide makes income depend on investments by level-two and level-three users and says the structure encourages duplication. Weekly prizes also include recruiting and team-growth contests. Those are not isolated references to a conventional one-level referral credit. They present expanding participation by other investors as a source of income, while the speaker invites viewers interested in joining to make contact.

citations.quote: Additional income sources include referral bonus, time-travel bonus, DNA matching bonus etc.
please contact us if you are interested in joining

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling these figures “referral calculations” understates what is displayed. The level-two and level-three example connects the viewer’s daily income to other users’ investments, and the contest slide rewards recruiting and team volume. A disclaimer about investment advice does not change the structure being promoted. The defense correctly notes that payouts are unverified; that makes the income illustrations less reassuring, not less central to the pitch.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The slides do depict multi-level and referral-linked calculations, but they identify them as examples of the plan. They do not show actual recruitment, payments, losses, or concealment of how the bonuses are calculated. The opening disclaimer also tells viewers to decide for themselves before investing. These features warrant caution about the platform; the cited material does not establish that the video’s explanation is itself deceptive.

opening.argument: Judge, the technology lesson also serves as a route into the investment plan. The description promises an explanation of decentralized applications and smart contracts. In the video, the explanation of liquidity pools and trading fees leads into priced packages, daily ROI claims and an investment button. The speaker then says viewers have an opportunity to connect and directs them to contact details or the company website. The issue is not whether DeFi concepts appear; it is what the presentation asks viewers to do after using those concepts to frame the return claims.

citations.quote: we break down the concept of decentralized applications, smart contract systems, and how modern DeFi platforms are evolving on BNB Smart Chain.
And if you want to get connected to connect then you have an opportunity to connect without missing anything
For details on the situation please go to the contact details in the description or you can go to the company official website to get the details

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to the description’s educational framing and the slide about fee generation. Both are present, but neither establishes that the projected package returns come from those fees. The package slide instead places daily ROI figures next to investment buttons, and the closing supplies a route to further contact. Describing the plan and promoting participation can happen in the same video.

citations.quote: For details on the situation please go to the contact details in the description or you can go to the company official website to get the details

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A presentation can include a participation route without concealing that it is discussing a specific platform. Here the description names DeFi GeneX, the slide lays out its claimed liquidity-to-fee sequence, and the disclaimer cautions viewers to make their own investment decision. The prosecution shows promotional elements, but no evidence that the stated mechanism was falsified or that the examples became actual payouts or losses.
